MEMO
To: All Staff
From: Facilities Management
Re: New Conference Room Booking Policy

Effective next Monday, all conference room reservations must be made at least 24 hours in advance through the online booking system. Same-day bookings will only be accepted if a room remains available after the 24-hour cutoff.

Additionally, meetings longer than two hours will require approval from a department manager. This policy is intended to reduce scheduling conflicts and ensure fair access to our limited meeting spaces.

Questions about the new policy should be directed to facilities@company.com.

We're excited to launch this year's Innovation Challenge, inviting employees from all departments to submit ideas that could improve our products, processes, or workplace culture. Submissions can be made individually or as a team of up to four people.

Notice: Office Relocation Information Session

As previously announced, our company will be relocating to a new office building at 450 Harbor Street starting next quarter. To help everyone prepare, we will be holding an information session next Wednesday at 3 PM in the main conference room.

Topics will include the moving timeline, new desk assignments, parking arrangements, and how to pack and label personal items for the move. Employees who cannot attend in person may join via video call.

Please submit any questions in advance through the relocation portal so we can address them during the session.

Sofia Novak

We'll cover both of these topics in more detail during Wednesday's session as well.

Best,
The Relocation Team
